regime_context: The Hang Seng theme ladder is led by Banks (crowded, mean-revert texture) with Energy in second on a trending durability leg — but only 5 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate ('narrowing' breadth, 0.29), so this is a low-participation, defensive/income-heavy tape, not a broad bull. Gate_helps is true, and the backtest verdict confirms the ONLY validated leg is drawdown/shake-out control via the trend gate — momentum rank is an attention lens only. All scorable-proxy themes (China Tech, Platform Tech) are ineligible/rank-lagging, so there is no clean tradable proxy among the leaders.
emerging_watch: Watch Telecom & Utilities (hk_telco_util) — score 0.68, breadth 0.833, hurst 'trend', but currently ineligible (below the trend gate) with a low durability_bar 0.53. If it regains eligibility (clears the absolute-trend gate) while staying non-crowded before end-November, that reads as a confirmed defensive-rotation handoff worth sizing.

theses.thesis: Energy is the only leader with a 'trend' hurst tag, superior durability_bar (0.71), and eligible status WITHOUT a crowding flag — the cleanest trend-gate-respecting relative leader in a narrowing tape. Topping at the leader is not a buy trigger; this is a relative-resilience lean in a defensive tape.
